latency_aggregation: 3 independent process blocks; median of first measurements in per-method fresh processes. Warm cohort: 30 warm-up cycles per method, then 7 timed rotating cycles per process; median per process then median over 3 processes. All 7 original post-first calls retained separately as startup transition. No timing rows dropped.
memory_definition: For every first/warm forward: reset PyTorch and native private-pool high-water marks; record each peak allocated/used and reserved. Sum of allocated+native-used peaks is a conservative upper bound, not simultaneous peak or total device residency. CUDA context/library memory is outside allocator totals. Fresh processes remove cross-method allocator history.
profiling_definition: Primary profile: mean of 5 event-instrumented forwards in warm block 0 after 30 warm-up and 7 timed cycles per method. Exclusive components sum to whole event duration. Query path includes small-support brute-force fallback, allocations/copies, and QuerySession value checks. GPU event intervals include stream idle time caused by host submission. Observed profile/pre-warm ratio includes instrumentation plus within-run variation. Original startup profiles remain in their raw records.
cohort_scope: Six size-selected scenes, twelve scene-model cases, first voxel pass; original full-760 scene matrix remains the population-scale result.

environment.precision: FP32 query/model input; unchanged frozen neural implementation
